title: Arlo Q Plus SSH Use of Hard-coded Credentials Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows attackers with physical access to escalate privileges on affected installations of Arlo Q Plus. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the SSH service. The device can be booted into a special operation mode where hard-coded credentials are accepted for SSH authentication. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of root.
